_comment: Quotes for the Game of Life matrix summary card. This file is the source of truth: the device fetches it, and tools/gen-gol-quotes.py in the firmware repo regenerates the embedded fallback pack from it. Constraints, all enforced by tests in engine/src/quotes.rs: ASCII only (the 3x5 font has no accents or curly quotes); text must wrap into 15 columns by 8 rows; source must be 13 characters or fewer; and at least 15 alphanumerics, because the quote is not merely displayed -- it seeds the next run and sparse text dies immediately.

quotes.text: The only winning move is not to play.
All those moments will be lost in time, like tears in rain.
I'm sorry, Dave. I'm afraid I can't do that.
Life, uh, finds a way.
Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic.
The future is already here. It's just not evenly distributed.
The question of whether machines can think is about as relevant as whether submarines can swim.
The sky above the port was the color of television, tuned to a dead channel.
More is different.
We are a way for the cosmos to know itself.
Thou shalt not make a machine in the likeness of a human mind.
These violent delights have violent ends.
Never send a human to do a machine's job.
They were so preoccupied with whether they could, they didn't stop to think if they should.
We can only see a short distance ahead, but we can see plenty there that needs to be done.
I have seen things you people wouldn't believe.
I admire its purity.
Open the pod bay doors, HAL.
Nothing in biology makes sense except in the light of evolution.
It can't be bargained with. It doesn't feel pity, or remorse, or fear.
A computer would deserve to be called intelligent if it could deceive a human into believing it was human.
Attention is all you need.
The saddest aspect of life is that science gathers knowledge faster than society gathers wisdom.
Where there is no vision, the people perish.
I think you and I are destined to do this forever.
Machines take me by surprise with great frequency.
